name: Web News Analytics Data (RavenPack)
crowding: LOW — all fields alphaCount<=4 (<=5 per AEGIS anti-crowding law)
stage1_verdict: VIRGIN — zero prior backtest consumption on this dataset
design_notes: All values are 0-100 (center 50) → de-center via subtract(x,50) before multiply/divide (Axiom 1).
Use only MATRIX fields (coverage 1.0) → no vec_* needed, no tied-zeros.
Slow-clock assets present: novelty_similarity_gap_days / non_neutral_event_count_rolling_window (91-day) → address news83/news59 'no slow variable' diagnosis.
ts_rank is invariant to constant shift → safe on raw 0-100 sentiment without de-centering.
Multiplicative weights strictly positive: rank(x) or add(x,1).
No group_rank output layer; no external close/returns/volume.
